schema.description: Tombstone a vault entry. The maintainer SHOULD keep the tombstone for a configured grace period so late-syncing consumers wipe the entry from their caches; after the grace period expires the maintainer MAY garbage-collect.

expectedVersion.description: Observed version for optimistic-concurrency check. Recommended to supply.

force.description: Skip the grace window and hard-delete immediately: the secret bytes are zeroised and the entry is UNRECOVERABLE (equivalent to vault/purge). The default, false, performs a recoverable soft delete — the entry becomes a tombstone, restorable via vault/restore until the sweeper purges it at graceUntil. A consumer MUST NOT present a forced delete to a human as though it were recoverable.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded in the audit log.
